purpose: Teach: 今年度/小規模/品目/原価/正社員/商社/同年/定例

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、今年度、絶対、犯罪対策、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police force is fully committed this fiscal year to strengthening crime prevention measures. We're genuinely grateful for that.
lines.style: Measured and official, but with underlying warmth. Clear enunciation on key commitments. Steady pace. Slight pause before 'grateful' to show sincerity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、小規模、絶対、事業者、絶対、にも、絶対、ご対応、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're truly appreciative of how the police have responded to the needs of small businesses like ours with such dedication.
lines.style: Earnest and engaged. Leaning forward slightly in posture. Warm tone without overstatement. Natural pacing, respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、犯罪、絶対、品目、絶対、分類、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are actively working to classify and categorize different types of crime more systematically. We're genuinely thankful for that effort.
lines.style: Professional and procedural. Steady delivery. Slight emphasis on 'systematically' to underscore the work involved. Even-toned, measured breathing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、捜査の、絶対、原価、絶対、ご説明、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We really appreciate how the police have explained the investigation process and costs to us so clearly.
lines.style: Sincere and nodding. Mid-range tone. Gentle emphasis on 'clearly' to acknowledge the transparency. Relaxed pacing, conversational warmth.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、正社員、絶対、職員、絶対、増員予定です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are planning to increase their full-time officer staffing this year. We're deeply grateful for that commitment.
lines.style: Formal announcement. Deliberate pacing on 'increase' and 'staffing'. Composed delivery. Slight weight on 'commitment' to show understanding of its significance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と、本気で、絶対、商社、絶対、合同、絶対、防犯訓練、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're very grateful for the joint crime prevention training that the police are conducting with businesses in the area.
lines.style: Warm and genuine. Steady, conversational tone. Slight lift on 'joint' to emphasize partnership. Natural breathing, present and engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、同年、絶対、入庁、絶対、警官、絶対、表彰、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're recognizing officers who joined in the same year with commendations. We're genuinely appreciative of their service.
lines.style: Official and ceremonial. Clear enunciation. Slight formality in the opening, warming toward sincerity on 'appreciative'. Measured, respectful cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、定例、絶対、地域会合、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're truly thankful for the regular community meetings that the police organize with us.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Mid-range, natural tone. Slight emphasis on 'regular' to underscore consistency and commitment. Relaxed, appreciative pacing.
